en: Well, that was quite an\nunfortunate turn of\ncircumstances.

To think that our search
for skin products would
end with us having to fight
off a large bird...

Thankfully we were able to
defeat it together. I am
curious, however, as to
why the birds around here
are so large and vicious.
The sun has started to go\ndown. How about we\nreturn to Lady Eleyna's?

In case you were
wondering, Lady Eleyna is
a very famous
fortune-teller and a close
friend.

One of my good friends is
currently with her and
helping out with her
housing situation.

You see, her former
dwelling got burned down
in a fire, and he's been
helping clean up.

Edge keeps telling us to
"leave the hard labor to
the men, and go for a
walk." Thanks to him, I've
got quite a bit of spare
time on my hands.
Edge is our crew leader. I\nhope I get to introduce\nyou to him, <player>.

Sounds like a
once-in-a-lifetime
opportunity, so what do
you say? Shall we go with
them, Captain?
We're here! This is Lady\nEleyna's new house.
So this famed\nfortune-teller lives in a\nhole in the wall...

And it seems a blue hunk
of junk has washed up on
her doorstep. No wonder
it was starting to get so
noisy.

Eek! H-how!? Only the
captain and our allies
should be able to see or
hear me!

I can see your scrawny
figure and hear your
grating voice as clear as
crystal.

I-I am so sorry! I did not
mean to offend Your
Ghostliness! Please, spare
me! May you rest in
peace!!!
Who are you calling\n"ghost"? I'm the great\nLady Eleyna.
Now tell me, what brings\nyou to this "hole in the\nwall"?

Y-your abode is
spectacular and no place
can match
its...mysteriousness,
L.A.D.Y. E.L.E.Y.N.A.
I already saw that Sarah\nwould bring you here.

You helped my good
friend. For this, I shall
grant you entrance and
even make you something
to eat.

If anyone wants to assist
me in the kitchen, do let
me know. You can use
what I have to make
whatever you wish.
Thank you. I'll lend a hand.\nCome on, everyone, let's\ngo in.

Lady Eleyna anticipated a
lot of people would be
coming to visit, which is
why she set aside so
much food for us.
Welcome back, Edge.\nThese people saved us\nwhen we got in trouble.

Is that right? Thank you,
everyone. I'm Edge
Maverick. Good to meet
you.
I see... So you guys are\nalso traveling through the\ngalaxy, huh?

I'm the captain of a small
spaceship, myself, and I
can tell you it hasn't been
easy. I've lost quite a few
people I consider to be
friends along the way.
Kid, I know you're busy\nmaking friends but go pick\nup the alley cat, will you?
By alley cat...do you mean\nMeracle?

I sent her out to go get
fish, but I sense she
doesn't intend to come
back for a while.
I can go, but I have no\nclue where to start looking\nfor her.

I do not want to use my
gift for something as
meaningless as this, but it
seems I am given no
choice.
Sigh...

Deep in the quiet woods, a
blue kitten has cast away
her fish in favor of
pursuing a leaf beetle.
Into a dark cave she goes,\nfurther and further still in\nsearch of her quarry...
What's wrong? Is she\nokay!?

This is one of Lady
Eleyna's auguries. Some
call it fortune-telling, but
it's more than that. She
can see your past, your
future...basically
everything.

*Pant* *Pant* ...The alley
cat's busy chasing an
insect. She's gone into a
cave.
<player>, go with this\nwhelp to find her.

Everyone else is busy
cooking in the kitchen.
You two don't appear to
be doing anything
significant.

If the captain's going, I am,
too! ...The kitchen is too
full for me to be of any
help.
Come on, you guys. Let's\nfind Meracle. It'll be good\nexercise before dinner!

So this must be the cave.
I wouldn't be surprised if
some dangerous animals
lived here. I hope Meracle
is okay.
...So what exactly makes\nMeracle an alley cat?

Meracle is one of our
friends. I suppose Lady
Eleyna calls her that
because she's a Lesser
Fellpool, meaning she's
part cat.
Let's hurry and find her.
I love cats!!!
She's a lucky girl to have\nso many friends.

Yeah. While Meracle's
fighting skills are nothing
to sniff at, this place
smells of danger.

Let's move quickly. That
way we can return to
Eleyna with good news
and eat the food everyone
else made.
Meracle loves to eat. She\nmight be keeled over with\nhunger around this time.
Huh? Really, Captain? I\nhad no idea...
Meracle has the ability to\ntransform into a kitten.\nShe's so fluffy and cute...

I never expected you to
become so excited when
talking about cats.
Perhaps I should request
to have my exterior body
modified to resemble a
cat.

You bet. There were so
many little coincidences
that eventually led us to
meeting her.

While we met her under
very difficult
circumstances, she
decided to put her trust in
us and let us save her.
It sounds like both of you\nhad it hard.
Wait up, you bug! Wait for\nmeow!
Hehehe! I've got you now!
Meow? I feel like I've seen\nthis stone somewhere\nbefore...

We are "one" who is "all."
"All" who are "one." We are
the endless ring that joins
totality.
Meow! My head... There's a\nvoice in my head!

Meooow! The rock and
bug melded together and
transformed into a
gigantic monster!

We are infinity. We are
perpetuity. Accept the
new universe that we shall
create.
This voice, meow... I can't\nthink straight...
Are you okay, Meracle!?
Edge!!!
It's a Grigori! Meracle, do\nyou think you can fight?
Of course! Let's take it\ndown together!
<player>, please lend us\nyour strength, as well!
You cannot defeat us. We\nare Armaros.
Now! Destroy the Grigori's\ncrystal!
You cannot destroy us.\nWe are infinite.

Armaros... I don't care how
many of you Grigori there
are─we will crush every
last one of you.

Grigori have a negative
effect on the environment
and cause deformation in
creatures. They're
extremely dangerous. To
think they still exist...
So those large and vicious\nAxe Beaks are because of\nthe Grigori.
Hehehe...
So you're <player>?\nThanks for your help.
*Kiss*
Also thank you missus for\nfighting with us, too.
*Kiss*
Eep!
Sh-she kissed me! And\nyou, too, Captain!!!

A kiss? A KISS!? The
captain's honor! This is a
crisis of universal
proportions!

Calm down. That's just
how Meracle expresses
her thanks to people.
Although, I still feel a little
embarrassed sometimes
by it, too...
Hmph! Why is everyone\nacting so bashful!?
Well... Isn't a kiss a bit\nmuch?
Hm? I hear someone\ncoming this way.
Alley cat!
L-Lady Eleyna!? What's\nwrong, meow?
How long have you been\nout catching fish for? The\nsun's already gone down.
Ouch! Lady Eleyna!
Leynie, you've gotta wait,\n'kay?
Reimi, Lymle... What brings\nyou two here?
I was drawing when Leynie\nsuddenly flew out the\nfront door.

She kept saying,
"Something happened to
Edge and Meracle," and
started running.
Lady Eleyna knows we are\nmore than capable of\ntaking on any enemies...

Even knowing that, I guess
she was worried about
you, Meracle, and came to
have a look.

Stop using your
imagination, whelp. I was
simply hungry and tired of
waiting.
Leynie's stubborn.
Just like you, Lymle.
No. That's not true.
You look empty-handed,\nalley cat. Where's the fish\nfor our dinner?
Oh, no! Meooow! I\ncompletely forgot about\nthat...
Thanks to your\ncarelessness we will have\none less dish.
I'm sorry, Lady Eleyna...
An Axe Beak? Huh... I\nhadn't even considered\nthat!
Lady Eleyna, we've got\nsome eggs and meat from\nthe bird we killed earlier.
Yay! I love birds and eggs,\nmeow!

Not so fast, alley cat. The
amount you slacked off
will be taken out of your
food.
No, not that... Please\nforgive me...
And so this part of the\nStar Ocean IV story\ncomes to a close.

We have a wide variety of
other tales planned for
the future. We hope you'll
look forward to them!
